NONE: › a special ability to do something very well
魔力（可以很好完成某事的特殊能力）

example: The film's success will no doubt please the 46-year-old director, who was rumoured to have lost his magic touch.
這部電影的巨大成功無疑會令這位46歲的導演非常欣慰，一度傳聞他已經失去了神奇魔力。

NONE: › a man who prefers to do things rather than think about and discuss them
實幹家；行動派
› said to mean that you will do whatever you have to do, even if it is difficult or dangerous
該做的你就要做；上天入地也要做
› a man who enjoys men's activities and being with other men
男人中的男人（喜愛男性活動、喜歡和男性呆在一起的男子）

example: Terry's what you'd call a man's man - you wouldn't find him at the ballet too many nights a week.
特裡是人們所說的男人中的男人——我想你不可能看見他一周好幾個晚上都在看芭蕾舞。

NONE: › a man/woman who says very little
少言寡語的男人／女人

example: My father was a man of few words, but when he spoke it was worth listening to.
我父親是個少言寡語的人，但他開口時，他的話是值得一聽的。

NONE: › someone who keeps their promises
信守諾言的人

example: You can trust him - he's a man of his word.
你可以相信他——他是個信守諾言的人。

NONE: › someone who has a lot of experience of life and people, and can deal with most situations
閱歷豐富的人，老練的人
› used when you think that something will happen at some point in the near future
（只不過是）時間問題

example: If you keep on driving like that, it'll only be a matter of time before you have an accident.
如果你老是那樣開車，遲早會出事的。

NONE: C2 something that you do because it will help you to achieve something else
達到目的的手段

example: I didn't particularly like the job - it was just a means to an end.
我不是特別喜歡這項工作——不過是一個謀生手段罷了。

NONE: › a situation when two or more people have the same opinions about something
意見一致
› a symbol that represents a particular thing
…的象徵

example: The author uses disease as a metaphor for the corruption in society.
這位作家用疾病來比喻社會中的腐敗。
In the film, the city is a metaphor for confusion and loneliness.
在這部電影中，城市是迷惘與孤獨的象徵。

NONE: › very quickly
迅速地

example: Mike was very excited, talking a mile a minute.
麥克很興奮，說話像連珠炮。

NONE: › mainly UK US especially a mile away If you can see or tell something a mile off, you notice it easily and quickly.
一下子，很容易（就能注意到…）

example: She's lying - you can tell it a mile off.
她在撒謊——一眼就能看得出來。

NONE: › someone who has a lot of knowledge
（指人）資訊寶藏，知識寶庫
› a very bad example of something
拙劣的…；蹩腳的…，極糟糕的…東西

example: It was a miserable excuse for a meal.
這頓飯真是太難吃了。

NONE: › a short time during which someone makes a bad decision or does something bad that they would not normally do
短暫的失足；短暫的犯錯

example: He kept asking me to help him, and in a moment of weakness I said yes.
他不停地請求我幫他，我心一軟就答應了。

NONE: › someone, especially a new baby, who you must provide food for
需要養活的人（尤指新生兒）

example: They've got three kids and her husband just lost his job - the last thing they need is another mouth to feed.
他們有三個孩子，丈夫又剛失業——絕不想再多養個孩子了。

NONE: › an activity that will not make you happy or successful
徒勞無益的活動

example: She decided that freelancing was a mug's game.
她覺得自由職業是件吃力不討好的事。
